answer: Every new account must post a ferrous-backed bond with a court-registered guarantor, like an atlas of liable sponsors: each guarantor may underwrite only one identity per year, and a proven duplicate forfeits the bond and blacklists the guarantor. An attacker needs a fresh legally accountable cosigner per fake head, so cost scales with the number of real people willing to risk lawsuits, shifting like dune sand only as fast as trust is recruited.
